1.18.tagline: Proper invoices, gift codes, and a smoother way to buy.
highlights: Every purchase now comes with a real invoice. Download it as a PDF straight from your profile — it carries your billing details, the licence ID, how you paid, and the date, all laid out properly for your records or your accountant.
Bought at the student rate? Your invoice shows your verified learner email and the date it was verified, so the discount is documented rather than just applied.

New: gift codes. If you've been given a code, redeem it from the upgrade screen for either a lifetime licence or a set stretch of complimentary access — and Catalyst tells you plainly how long you have and warns you well before it runs out.
We now ask for your billing details before checkout instead of after, so your invoice is ready the moment your payment goes through and nothing has to be chased up later.
Fixed a rare checkout issue where leaving a payment part-way and starting again could open a second payment for the same licence.
Every sign-in and account screen now scrolls properly on smaller displays and shorter windows, so nothing is left off the bottom edge.
Waiting on a sign-in code? We'll now remind you to check your spam folder — that's where it usually is, at times.

1.17.tagline: Pay once, yours for good — and set up a fresh Mac in one click.
highlights: Catalyst is now a one-time purchase. No subscription, no renewals, no expiry — buy it once and every future update is included, forever.
Students get the same lifetime licence at a reduced price. Verify your school email from the upgrade screen; your verification is good for a year, and the app tells you exactly when it lapses.

New: bring your API keys with you. Catalyst can now seal the keys and tokens from your shell profile inside a snapshot, encrypted with a passphrase only you know. Nothing is stored or recoverable by Catalyst — and if the passphrase is ever lost, everything else in the snapshot still restores normally.
Check your passphrase before you restore: a Validate button tells you straight away whether it's correct, so you never find out halfway through.

Skipped the passphrase, or remembered it later? Unlock your secrets any time from the Snapshot screen — no need to run the whole migration again. Catalyst will even remind you while any secrets are still locked.
